Edji


I made a new map! I tried to make a map that could have interesting gameplay so I hope you all enjoy!

Map Creator: Tynvale

Map Download: PM me on Skype if you want it!

Please give as much feedback as possible, I want the community to be happy with it.

replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Edji, has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you remove most of the void space off the map. The monuments are awkward as well as they are close to each other. Make it less flat by adding more structures as well.

I personally suggest you add more structures/islands.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may reubmit your map once edited.
